split_note: Split from ST_ENTREPOT per the interest-researcher's own recommendation. Represents UK, Ireland, Luxembourg -- the weaponization-willing cluster, functionally coordinated with the US/EU sanctions architecture.
horizon_driver: Alliance-alignment reputational capital matters more here than pure neutrality-franchise value; treat horizon as medium (4-5yr), tracking electoral and alliance cycles more than the entrepot-neutral cluster does.

constraints.source: The UK committed GBP2.26bn/$2.93bn to the G7 reparations-loan structure early and eagerly, ahead of most EU peers.
constraints.breaks_under: already broken in the low-cost direction -- this is a real, revealed low-cost action for this cluster, not a binding constraint

stated_vs_revealed.stated: The UK, alongside other financial entrepots, administers global capital neutrally and apolitically.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The UK moved fastest and most eagerly of any entrepot to commit real money (GBP2.26bn/$2.93bn) to the G7 reparations-loan structure backed by frozen Russian assets -- an active, belligerent-side financial posture, not neutral custody.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: This cluster's actual franchise is alliance-aligned financial capacity, not neutrality -- the opposite of the entrepot group's stated self-image.

tripwires.if: the EU fully mobilizes its reparations-loan structure beyond the EUR90bn Dec 2025 tranche
tripwires.then: this cluster (UK, Ireland, Luxembourg) matches with parallel commitments rather than resisting

what_would_change_my_mind: A UK/Ireland/Luxembourg divergence on a future sanctions-adjacent asset question would undercut treating this as one coherent cluster.
